thread:
emily_support: Customer reported they applied two promo codes but only one credit showed up. says the old free-trial promo (TRIAL50) disappeared after they applied PROMO20. customer expects them to stack. account: acct_8a7b. screenshot: https://rwd-inference.s3/priv/acct_8a7b/promo-snap.png

sam_billing: thanks — can you paste the exact promo codes and steps the customer took? also need the stripe customer id and the date/time they did it.

emily_support: pasted from convo — codes = TRIAL50, PROMO20. steps: 1) signed up -> auto-trial applied 2) tried to redeem code PROMO20 via dashboard -> showed success toast 3) balance updated but trial credit disappeared. they did this earlier today (~13:02 UTC). stripe_cust: cus_Jk9FQ.

josh_eng: quick note — our promo service has two promo "kinds": trial and credit. current logic: applyPromo() will set promo_id on the billing_profile if promo.kind == "trial" OR promo.kind == "credit" — but if promo.kind differs and the incoming promo has priority flag, we overwrite. that can cause trial -> credit swap.

emily_support: is that expected? customer insists they should be additive for this account type (startup-tier free trial + promotional credit).

josh_eng: not expected from product perspective. looks like a rule mismatch between promo-engine and billing rules. sending minimal repro:```http
POST /v1/accounts/acct_8a7b/promos/apply
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "code": "PROMO20",
  "source": "dashboard"
}
```this triggers db update:```sql
UPDATE billing_profiles SET promo_code = 'PROMO20', promo_kind = 'credit' WHERE account_id = 'acct_8a7b';
-- previous promo TRIAL50 row left in promotions_history but not active
```

billing-bot: [audit] 2026-03-12T13:02:11Z apply_promo acct=acct_8a7b code=TRIAL50 result=activated by=system
billing-bot: [audit] 2026-03-12T13:02:47Z apply_promo acct=acct_8a7b code=PROMO20 result=activated by=user (emily_customer)

ash_finance: we should manual-credit the missing trial dollars now and set a flag so the promo engine doesn't overwrite again. what's the delta the customer expects?

emily_support: customer says they lost 50 USD trial credit and got 20 USD promo credit instead — net balance lower. requests immediate restore of trial 50 and allow promo 20 on top.

sam_billing: plan: 1) manual +$50 to acct_8a7b 2) add account tag promo-preserve to prevent overwrite 3) ticket to engineering to change applyPromo merge behavior. i can do steps 1-2 now. will confirm after crediting.

josh_eng: for engineering fix: change applyPromo to merge credits when existing promo.kind == 'trial' and incoming.kind == 'credit' (both additive). also add a strict audit check so UI shows "this will replace existing promo" only when it actually will. i'll open PR and mark as high priority. interim workaround: use admin endpoint to create a stacked credit row instead of replacing billing_profile.promo_code. example:```http
POST /admin/acct_8a7b/promos
{
  "code": "PROMO20",
  "stack_with": "TRIAL50"
}
```

ash_finance: pls include instructions for support to run the admin endpoint safely. i'll approve manual credit.

emily_support: noted. customer asked for ETA on fix?

josh_eng: PR opened -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/promo-fix/pulls/128 — target patch release in next deploy window (tomorrow morning PST) if QA passes. hotfix possible same-day if we see more cases.

sam_billing: credited +$50 at 2026-03-12T14:05Z. added tag promo-preserve. emailed customer and offered apology + one-month free premium tier as goodwill.

emily_support: customer confirmed balance restored and appreciated fast response :thumbsup: they accepted the goodwill offer.

josh_eng: follow-up: i'll add unit tests for three cases (trial+credit, credit+trial, two credits). also adding metrics to catch promo overwrites.

emily_support: thanks team — closing thread once PR merges and metrics look good. :white_check_mark:
